comment_regular: Verified active-effect list load lifecycle: destroys current effects and clears old list nodes, reads the UInt16 effect count (and optional BLOK header), loads each record through ActiveEffect_Base_Load, then inserts valid effects sorted by MagicTarget_ActiveEffectComparisonFunc. The loop also retains save-buffer boundary checks and handles the Vampirism-effect special case.
